rules.alternatives: NCCPA certification or recertification during the 2-year licensure period may be accepted in lieu of the 100 hours; Vermont-required CME (controlled substances) still applies.
rules.audit_note: Proof of completion is submitted with the renewal application; missing required CME falls under the make-up provisions of Rules 24.3-24.4.

topics.who: PAs who prescribe controlled substances (DEA registrants or pending applicants are presumed to); AMA PRA Cat 1, AAPA Cat 1 or board-designated

rules.notes: PA licenses renew January 31 of even years. Practice agreements must be reviewed within 90 days before renewal.
rules.legal_basis: Vermont Board of Medical Practice Rules 30.0, 32.4 (eff. 5/1/2024)
